title: Lob Over the Press Release
description: Against an aggressive deny press, a tall or athletic player breaks long for a lob pass over the top of the pressure as a release valve.

content.objective: Use a well-timed deep pass over the press as a release valve when short outlets are denied.
content.setup: A deny press covers the short outlets tightly, leaving a long release open behind the defense.
instructions: If short outlets are fully denied, a teammate breaks long behind the press.
The inbounder delivers a high, accurate lob over the pressure.
The long receiver catches in stride and advances immediately.
Reset with the short-outlet options tried first before using the long release.
coachingPoints: Use the long release as a last option, not the first instinct.
Throw with enough height to clear outstretched hands safely.
The long receiver must be a reliable catcher under pressure.
commonMistakes: Throwing the long pass as a first option instead of exhausting short outlets.
Underthrowing the lob into a defender's reach.
Standing still instead of working to get open against the pressure.
content.safety: The long pass should have a safe, high arc, not a flat, risky throw.
